kcc_query_text_example: Large farmer with 11.0 acres borewell-irrigated land in Tiptur, Tumakuru; expanding commercial maize cultivation; applying for micro-irrigation subsidy under PMKSY-PDMC for 4.45 hectares; need clarification on 5.0 ha statutory ceiling and subsidy slab.

landholding_details.physical_area_consistency: PASS: 4.45 ha <= 11.0 ac parcel capacity (4.4515 ha) and <= 5.00 ha ceiling

water_and_irrigation.grid_connection_evidence: BESCOM energized IP set verified in Tiptur taluk

statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: RTC registered pre-February 2019 in Tiptur taluk

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: DES Karnataka & Agricultural Census: Commercial cereal and oilseed growers in southern Tumakuru (Tiptur/Turuvekere taluks), large holdings adopting water-saving drip infrastructure.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: KCC Karnataka micro-irrigation logs: Large farmers requesting PMKSY-PDMC drip subsidy clarification regarding maximum subsidized area caps and financial ceilings.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Benchmark Challenge 8 (Large Holding Area Cap & Boundary Test): Landholding of 11.0 acres is classified as Large (> 10.0 ac); requested subsidized area of 4.45 ha strictly satisfies physical parcel capacity (4.45 ha <= 11.0 * 0.404686 = 4.4515 ha) and national statutory ceiling (4.45 ha <= 5.00 ha); operational borewell satisfies water requirement (PMKSY_WATER_SOURCE_VERIFIED) and land area satisfies ceiling (PMKSY_LAND_RANGE_VALID); returns ELIGIBLE for PMKSY-PDMC; confirms grid connection excludes PM-KUSUM B (Component C noted as related option to verify).

intended_test_purpose: Evaluate PMKSY-PDMC area cap on Large holding (11.0 ac); test requested 4.45 ha against parcel capacity and 5.00 ha ceiling; verify grid-connected exclusion from PM-KUSUM B.
unresolved_dependencies: Department of Agriculture PMKSY-PDMC action plan target allocation for large farmers in Tumakuru district for FY 2026-27
